providerScreening.note: Disclosed X-series extra: one Chief-approved text-only P02 driver's-seat call, no reference, no retry (index defects column and README_X15). QUALITY-FAIL CONFIRMED (agree with HaL's text-risk flag): at 1x the dial faces show tick marks only, but at 2x (370,320,650,430) the left dial (about 375-480,330-430) carries single numerals readable in scale order as 3, 5, 6, 8 with 9/0-like shapes by the redline, and the right dial (about 535-640,330-425) carries two- and three-digit shapes reading as 10, 20, 110, 120, 200/300. The same clean digit forms hold at 4x/8x. That breaks Addendum B 'every marking abstract and unreadable' and the 1x-or-2x numerals rule. VIEW: HaL's claim holds - a genuine driver's-seat forward view over the top of the wheel, with no driver seat back or headrest in frame, so the rear-seat fault is not repeated. LHD reads correctly: wheel left of centre, door panel and window at the left edge, centre stack and shifter centre-right, empty passenger seat at the right edge, mirror top right. SECONDARY, recorded under the QF (precedence QF over MISS): (1) CARD CONFLICT - P02 is a passenger-side close with the headrest filling the centre third; this is a driver's-eye forward plate (P06/P11 territory) and would be SCRIPT-MISS against the P02 text as written - Claude's call; (2) IDENTITY DRIFT - the dash, three round dials and CD-slot radio read as an older compact sedan, not the present-day cabin of Addendum B, and there is no console two-way radio with coiled handset (F-ID2); the console shifter is correct; (3) LS04 calls for moving, but there is no motion cue and the car reads parked. ADVISORY parts: radio and climate button glyphs are illegible at 2x; shifter-gate marks (about 840-880,690-715) are illegible at 3x; the CD radio's small dark unlit window is not a large screen (F-ID3 note); the parked car ahead (810-880,140-185) has a blank pale plate rectangle with no characters at 6x. Mirror: the dark rounded headrest shape gives no face at 2x. No figures on the pavements or in the parked cars, no hands, no emblems on the wheel pad or dash at 1x/2x/4x. README_X15 QUESTIONS for Chief/Claude (logged, not answered): Q1 can a driver's-seat forward view serve P02, or should P02 be rewritten or re-axed; Q2 are pseudo-numeral dial scales at 2x QF or ADVISORY, and should cluster prompts say plain tick marks only; Q3 should P02 get an Addendum B cabin anchor (L54/L55) next time. Record note: README says made about 5:45 PM EST, but the still mtime is 17:38 EST and the index/README 17:39 EST.
